children: India's largest two-wheeler maker, Hero MotoCorp Ltd, on Sunday (November 1) reported total dispatches of 7,34,403 units in October 2026, registering a year-on-year (YoY) growth of 16% compared with 6,35,808 units in the same month last year, the company said on Sunday (November 1).

The growth was driven by its domestic internal combustion engine (ICE) business, which recorded dispatches of 6,75,017 units, up 14% from 5,90,806 units in October 2025. Scooters and 100cc motorcycles led the growth in the domestic ICE segment.
Retail momentum also remained healthy, with registrations through the VAHAN portal reaching 5,89,665 units as of November 1, excluding Telangana.
VIDA, Hero MotoCorp's emerging mobility business unit, recorded dispatches of 30,143 units in October 2026. Its VAHAN retail registrations grew 80% year-on-year during the month.

VIDA's market share in the electric two-wheeler segment increased to 13.6% in October 2026 from 11.1% in the corresponding month last year. The brand also ran a festive campaign featuring Anil Kapoor and Ranbir Kapoor, built around the theme 'Ghar Ghar Tyohar, Ghar Ghar EVOOTER'.
The VIDA x KKR campaign won two awards at the AdAura Awards 2026 — Brand Collaboration Campaign of the Year and Sports Marketing Campaign of the Year.
Hero MotoCorp strengthened its premium motorcycle portfolio with the launch of the new Xtreme 160R 4V and Xtreme 250R during October.

The company's global business recorded dispatches of 29,319 units in October 2026. Hero MotoCorp said it continued to strengthen its portfolio, supported by a pipeline of upcoming scooter and premium motorcycle launches.
Retail momentum remained strong in key international markets, particularly Colombia and Bangladesh.
On Friday (October 30), shares of Hero MotoCorp Ltd ended at ₹5,152.40, up by ₹45.40, or 0.89%, on the BSE.

title: Hero MotoCorp October Sales: Dispatches up 16% to 7.34 lakh units; VIDA retail jumps 80%
